title: Negated input gate values
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a Boolean assignment to its $n$ inputs, and let $k$ be an input index. In the gate list consisting of the negation gates for all inputs, the value at vertex $n+k$ is the negation of $x_k$.
